description: This file defines the WhileBlock class, which represents a while loop construct within the SCSSPHP compiler's internal AST. It extends the Block class and sets its type to indicate a while loop.

classes.name: WhileBlock
classes.description: Represents a while loop construct in SCSSPHP's internal syntax tree, storing condition information and inheriting block behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of WhileBlock, setting its type to indicate a 'while' loop.
